lines.en: I shift along in little hops.
My frilled edge quivers in the wind.

lines.zh: 我拖着湿漉漉的身体走
lines.en: I drag my wet body along.
Red mist trails and spreads behind me.

lines.zh: 我在地上留下一片红斑
lines.en: I leave red patches on the ground.

lines.zh: 我从绯红的草里挤过去
lines.en: I squeeze through the crimson grass.

lines.zh: 我朝着有热气的地方走
lines.en: I head for the warm, rising air.
I move slowly, swelling and sinking.
My body is trembling.
I scrape a line across the ground.
I skirt the lava flow.

lines.zh: 我留下一路黏滑的红斑。
lines.en: I leave a trail of slick red patches.
I swell up, then subside.
This crimson ground is mine.
Small bubbles rise on my surface.
I hear something popping far off.
I turn a little, slowly.
Spores are drifting out of me.

lines.zh: 岩浆的暖意让我松开了褶边。
lines.en: The lava's warmth loosens my frill.

lines.zh: 我不动的时候像块石头
lines.en: When I'm still, I look like stone.
My color is deepening.

lines.zh: 我贴在地上，几乎融进去
lines.en: I lie so close I almost blend in.
I reek of blood. Do not sniff.
I swell toward you once.

lines.zh: 这东西没有眼睛，但我看得见
lines.en: I have no eyes, yet I see you.
You step back; I follow half a step.
You shouldn't have stepped onto this ground.
My spores have already spread.
You're breathing a little fast.

lines.zh: 绯红的草缠着我的褶边。
lines.en: Crimson grass tangles my frill.

lines.zh: 你站在绯红的地上，很显眼
lines.en: You stand out on this crimson ground.

lines.zh: 我朝你这边的地面靠近
lines.en: I near the ground where you stand.
Part of me collapses.
The red mist disperses for a moment.
I contract to guard my center.
Bloodlike fluid runs out.
A tear in my frill.
I slowly swell back.
That made me sluggish.

lines.zh: 被打掉的一块滚进了草里。
lines.en: A knocked-off piece rolls into the grass.
Spores gather at the wound.
I'm here, and I'll grow back.
I don't eat such things.
Set it on the ground.
I don't need feeding.
I don't know that smell.
I lean toward it once.
Then I retreat.
This is no use to me.
Keep it.
The ground interests me more.
Stop waving it; it irritates me.
You hit me and something splashes.
My body is clammy.
I slide half a foot aside.
You stepped into my frill.
I tighten up once.
A new red patch on the ground.
Our contact made no sound.
The bloody spore drifts aside.
You're so hard. I don't like it.
Don't press in again.

lines.zh: 我是从孢子里长出来的
lines.en: I grew from a spore.
Such a thing needs no companion.
I only divide.
Go. Don't come near.

lines.zh: 我的孢子会落在你身上
lines.en: My spores would settle on you.
That would be bad for you.
Being alone suits me.
This ground is enough for me.
Splitting is enough; no mate needed.
Don't reach out.

lines.zh: 我用黏液裹紧这块东西。
lines.en: I wrap this thing tight in slime.
It changes color at once.
I can't digest this.
One taste, and the soil flavor is too strong.
I push it with my body.

lines.zh: 它沉进我的身体，不动了。
lines.en: It sinks into my body and stops moving.
I leave what's left on the ground.
This piece is somewhat interesting.
I move it toward the lava.
I don't need to collect anything.
Something warm has come near.
This spore of mine is all blood.
It's inside my ground.
I begin releasing spores.
My color has brightened.
It hasn't noticed.
I creep toward it.
I know this crimson place.
A little closer and I can touch it.
I swell up.
My frill is fully spread.
One touch is enough.

lines.zh: 那片地上的红印是新的
lines.en: Those red marks on the ground are new.
I close around it from every side.
The grass under it is turning black.
I draw in air and swell.
The bloody spore inches forward.
It retreats, and I slow down.
My spores arrive first.
It's started coughing.
More red patches on the ground.
It's looking for a way out.
There's no other way out here.
I press toward it.
Only two steps between us.
Spores already drift at your feet.
I spread slowly along the ground.

lines.zh: 它的脚印我一个个盖住
lines.en: I cover its footprints one by one.
I press it toward the rock wall.

lines.zh: 它的脚印全被我的红斑盖住。
lines.en: My red patches cover every footprint it leaves.

lines.zh: 孢子已经在它的衣服上了
lines.en: The spores are already on its clothes.
Its breathing is heavier than before.
I lurch and cling to it.
Red mist wraps around it.
My body burns against it.
It shudders and pulls back.
Red mist smothers its mouth and nose.
My spores are all over this ground.
It has stopped moving.
I draw myself back, slowly.
I gather myself on the ground again.
Quiet now.
I leap and cling to its leg.
It shakes twice and can't throw me off.

lines.zh: 我身上有一部分留在了那里
lines.en: Part of me stays stuck there.
When it treads on me, I spread apart.

lines.zh: 我从绯红的地里鼓起来
lines.en: I swell up out of the crimson ground.
The air is full of spores.

lines.zh: 我还没凝成完整的形状。
lines.en: I haven't set into a full shape yet.
I try moving an inch forward.
I know this heat.
I slowly spread my frill.
The ground has taken my color.
I hear fire crackling far off.

lines.zh: 我从绯红的土里鼓成一团。
lines.en: I swell into a mass from the crimson soil.
Something living is on this ground.
I swell toward that direction.
I begin to move.
The fire makes me swell.
I fall from a height and splatter.
Water washes my spores away.
Chunks fly apart and flow back together.

lines.zh: 一根尖物扎进我的身体
lines.en: Something sharp buries in my body.

lines.zh: 这股力量抽走了我的水
lines.en: This force draws my moisture out.
There's nothing for me to eat.
Lightning strikes and I ball up.

lines.zh: 我散成一片红雾落下去
lines.en: I scatter into red mist and fall.
